report:
Reviewed the complete meta.book.crates_landing claim and both ordinary implementation entries (book.rs generate_crates and spec.rs render_chapter), plus the sole ordinary associated test curated_crates_landing_preserves_prose_and_links_to_generated_chapters. There are no TODO/N/A entries.

Requirement 1, handwritten Markdown survives: preprocess renders existing sections through render_sections and render_chapter; render_chapter copies every segment outside replacements unchanged. generate_crates updates only the landing sub_items, never its content. The test now compares the entire rendered landing with the original handwritten text after the intended .sage-to-.html link replacement, retaining its heading and introductory prose, and separately rejects any iframe on that page.

Requirement 2, curated introductions link to rendered chapters and modeled entities: the captured real Crates README provides the subsystem reading map and links to owning .sage chapters. chapter_replacements resolves relative source destinations against the source chapter, checks published .sage targets, obtains their rendered URLs, computes relative URLs, and retains entity fragments. The test uses a symbols.sage#item:demo::symbols::Item destination and explicitly asserts the corresponding symbols.html entity URL. Companion guide assertions also exercise a relative symbols.sage chapter link without an entity fragment.

Requirement 3, generated crate and module chapters are descendants of this landing rather than replacements: generate_crates creates crate children under the landing and module children under the owning crate, with inherited parent names and numbering. The strengthened test inspects actual sub_items for demo/crate.sage beneath the landing and symbols.sage beneath demo. It also verifies companion guide ancestry. Together these assertions detect both flattening and replacement of the landing content. The existing explorer book-data home assertion corroborates the preserved landing destination.

Read the fixture construction, actual binary invocation, recursive chapter lookup, and script-data extraction through captured review reads. Essential claim behavior resides in the two associated implementation files, including their local rendering, source-link, URL, and hierarchy helpers; no production behavior changes or extra associations were required. A fresh review was started after strengthening the test and after the concurrent book_explorer attribute addition, and the fresh annotated test and metadata were inspected. Source assessment is distinct from execution: cargo fmt completed and cargo test -p sage-meta --test book curated_crates_landing_preserves_prose_and_links_to_generated_chapters passed (1 test). Centralized workspace/quality validation is coordinated separately by root. No requested edits remain.
